GMT watch explained: how a second hour hand reads a second time zone.

Rolex GMT-Master II 126710GRNR: USD 12,000. Tudor Black Bay GMT M79830RB-0010: USD 5,275. Prices per Watches of Switzerland, checked 26 November 2026.

TUDOR says its Black Bay GMT hour hand can be jumped to set local time when you cross time zones.

Which would you travel with, the Rolex or the Tudor?
